senses.gloss: phuphu-kāra (onomat.; cf. phutphukārakam), one of the noises made by Māraʼs host, described as horrible and harsh: (kecid bhinna-vikṛta-bhairava-)rūkṣa-svarāḥ phuphukāra-(v.l. huṃhuṃkāra, and so Calc.; Tib. similarly hu hu; Lefm. em. phutphutkāra-)-picutkāra-(q.v.)-phuluphulu-(q.v.; most mss. ˚la; Calc. and Tib. huluhulu-)-prakseditāni kurvanti sma LV 〔306.(2—)3〕.
